title: Domain placement without portable task priority or QoS
question: Can physical scheduling policy vary without creating a source priority surface or changing W semantic contracts?

sources.scope: task priority inheritance and escalation require structured semantics
task executor selection is distinct from serial actor isolation
conditional fairness does not specify ready-task order
virtual threads ignore setPriority and retain normal priority

stopCondition: Stop when source absence, receipt visibility, fixed-logical-trace derivation, preservation of contract-guaranteed order with variation only where order is unspecified, safe allergy terminals, conditional single-CPU progress, and the complete reopen gate are derived without simulating a W runtime.
